Package hu.bme.mit.theta.svlib.frontend.dsl.gen

Interface SvLibListener

All Superinterfaces:
org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
All Known Implementing Classes:
SvLibBaseListener
public interface SvLibListener extends org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
This interface defines a complete listener for a parse tree produced by SvLibParser.
